content.short: ADA Anvil provides Cardano NFT minting, multi-sig rewards, airdrops, and project tooling for teams online.
content.description: Ada Anvil provides advanced solutions for Web3 projects via a variety of services. Multi-sig minting made easy! Elevate your projects minting experience with fast, secure and easy-to-use multi-sig minting. A flexible set of tools built to scale with any project. Deliver fungible, and non-fungible rewards to your holders with our simple multi-sig staking platform. An affordable solution for projects that need to airdrop assets to their holders! We can handle the snapshot, logic, and delivery of fungibles, and non-fungibles.
